CMOS differential LC oscillator
.include "circuit.spice"
.include "models.spice"
VDD vdd 0 3.3
VTANK vtank 0 1.8
IREF vdd iref 200u
.ic v(lp)=1.81 v(lm)=1.79
XDUT vdd vtank 0 iref lp lm outp outm astra_041_cmos_differential_lc_oscillator
.temp 27
.options method=gear reltol=1e-5
* @spec swing range 0.3 10 unit=V
* @spec period range 5e-8 8e-8 unit=s
* @spec phigh range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec plow range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
* @spec mhigh range 3.2 3.4 unit=V
* @spec mlow range -0.01 0.01 unit=V
.control
set filetype=ascii
tran 200p 4u
let vd=v(lp)-v(lm)
meas tran swing PP vd FROM=2u TO=4u
meas tran period TRIG vd VAL=0 RISE=40 TARG vd VAL=0 RISE=41
meas tran phigh MAX v(outp) FROM=2u TO=4u
meas tran plow MIN v(outp) FROM=2u TO=4u
meas tran mhigh MAX v(outm) FROM=2u TO=4u
meas tran mlow MIN v(outm) FROM=2u TO=4u
write out.raw
quit
.endc
.end
